row.evidence: Hyperproof's help centre says 'Hyperproof supports SCIM provisioning for users and groups from Okta and Microsoft Entra ID' and can 'add, update, and deactivate users'; there are no public plans or prices, so SCIM can only be bought through sales.
row.notes: Quote-only: Hyperproof publishes no plan names or prices (pricing page blocked to curl and the renderer; a WebFetch read showed no plan table), so SCIM is recorded as gated at low confidence. SCIM 2.0 for users and groups is documented for Okta (OIN app with SCIM create, update, deactivate and group push) and Microsoft Entra ID (a second, non-gallery enterprise app alongside the OIDC SSO app). SSO must be configured first and Hyperproof Support must enable the SCIM feature for the organization. The Admin generates a SCIM endpoint URL and bearer token (a second token can be created for rotation). Removing a user in the IdP deactivates them in Hyperproof (work can be reassigned, user can be reactivated). Roles come from IdP role assignment (Entra app roles ORGANIZATION_ADMINISTRATOR, COMPLIANCE_MANAGER, USER, LIMITED_ACCESS_USER), default Limited access user. JumpCloud is SSO only (SAML). The REST API (OAuth2 client credentials) can list users and manage groups and object role assignments but cannot create or deactivate users.

auth.token_source: Settings > Authentication > Provisioning toggle (SCIM Endpoint URL and Bearer Token)
auth.notes: A second token can be created to rotate the one in use.

operations.notes: Okta lists 'Import new users and profile updates' (read); Entra lists 'Deactivate groups'. Profile updates supported; PUT vs PATCH not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: User is deactivated; their work can be reassigned to another user and they can be reactivated from the Users list.

attributes.notes: Entra guide: remove name.formatted, addresses, phoneNumbers, timezone, externalId, displayName and enterprise employeeId, department, manager mappings ('Hyperproof doesn't use them'); roles is a multi-valued string.

roles.how: Assign Hyperproof roles in the IdP (Entra app roles with values ORGANIZATION_ADMINISTRATOR, COMPLIANCE_MANAGER, USER, LIMITED_ACCESS_USER, sent in the roles attribute); unassigned users get Limited access user.

limitations.text: SCIM is only for Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.
The Provisioning menu only appears after SSO is configured and Hyperproof Support enables the SCIM feature on request.
Entra needs two apps (one for OIDC SSO, a second non-gallery app for SCIM); sync runs every 40 minutes and is not configurable; group provisioning needs Entra P1 or P2.
No invitation emails are sent to SCIM-provisioned users.

auth.notes: Scopes are per object (e.g. control.read); user and group scope names not checked.

capabilities.notes: Users API is read-only (GET /me, GET /). Role assignments are per object, not organization roles.

rate_limits.text: No fixed limits; throttling returns HTTP 429 during high activity.

limitations.text: No API endpoint to create, invite, update or deactivate users.

okta.notes: OIN functionality list checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push (read from the page markup).

entra.notes: Non-gallery app for SCIM; learn.microsoft.com hyperproof-tutorial returns 404.

jumpcloud.notes: Hyperproof documents JumpCloud SAML SSO; SCIM is Okta and Entra only. JumpCloud catalogue page not checked.

fallbacks.notes: CSV-imported users are added as contacts without a role.

open_questions: No public plan or price list; which contract tiers include SSO and SCIM is unknown.
SCIM version, base URL pattern, filtering, pagination and token expiry are not documented.
Whether deactivation frees a paid seat or ends sessions is not documented.
Whether an audit-log API exists was not found in the developer portal.
